name: Beppin Mama ~Love Love Boshi Yuugi~
original_name: べっぴんママ ～ラブラブ母子遊戯～
source:
Akira, studying for his entrance exams next year, spends his spring break alone with his beloved mother, Chizuru.
Chizuru is the envy of all his friends, and his favorite beautiful mama.
She teaches him kindly and slowly all he needs to know for his exams.
But it's not studying Akira needs to worry about, it's his Aunt Kanae, who's come to live with them!
His real mother, a widow and a former teacher who spoils her son,
and his Aunt Kanae, an active spartan teacher who laughs at Akira's weaknesses.
Akira starts to learn about the sweet and harsh world of adults.
His full-figured passionate mother and aunt become his tutor in the arts of ejaculation!
He becomes a slave to the wills of these hot-tempered women, full of sexual desire...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032287.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
明正在为明年的入学考试而学习，他和他深爱的母亲千鹤独自度过了春假。
千鹤是他所有朋友羡慕的对象，也是他最喜欢的美丽妈妈。
她亲切而缓慢地教他考试所需的一切。
但阿基拉需要担心的不是学习，而是他的香苗姨妈，她来和他们住在一起了！
他的亲生母亲是一位寡妇，也是一位溺爱儿子的前老师，
还有他的阿姨佳苗，一位活跃的斯巴达式老师，她嘲笑阿基拉的弱点。
阿基拉开始了解成人世界的甜蜜与严酷。
他丰满热情的母亲和阿姨成为他射精艺术的导师！
他成为了这些脾气暴躁、充满性欲的女人的意志的奴隶……
